hero_subhead: Dangerous trees, overgrown branches, storm damage in Sheffield? We remove the risk safely and leave your garden looking better.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Sheffield
services_subhead: From routine pruning to emergency felling, we handle every aspect of professional arboriculture with safety and care.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, controlled removal of dangerous or unwanted trees. We manage access, site clearance, and chip all waste on-site to minimise disruption to your Sheffield property.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Reduce height and spread without harming the tree. Expert pruning improves light, air flow, and health while keeping your garden balanced and safe.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Complete stump removal below ground level using specialist grinding equipment. Reclaim garden space and eliminate regrowth in one visit.

services.title: Storm Damage & Emergency Work
services.desc: Fallen branches, split trunks, uprooted trees—we respond within 48 hours to secure your property and make the site safe again.

services.title: Tree Planting & Aftercare
services.desc: We advise on species selection, soil preparation, and establishing new trees. Ongoing support ensures healthy, vigorous growth for years to come.

services.title: Hedge Cutting & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular trimming keeps hedges dense and attractive. We handle any height or density, and dispose of all clippings responsibly.

about_pullquote: Good tree care should respect the tree and the neighbourhood. That's what we do.
about_para_1: Canopy Craft has been caring for Sheffield's trees for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many trees butchered by cowboys with a chainsaw and no knowledge. Today, we're a fully qualified, insured team working to arboricultural standards—NPTC certified, and backed by public liability insurance up to £10 million. Every job, from a small prune to emergency storm clearance, is planned with the tree's long-term health and your safety in mind.
about_para_2: You'll find us on domestic gardens, conservation areas, and commercial sites across South Yorkshire. Customers trust us because we listen, we explain our work, and we leave your garden cleaner than we found it. Many of our jobs come from word-of-mouth recommendation—the best compliment an arborist can get.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Canopy Craft

reviews.text: Had three massive conifers taken down that were blocking the light from the back garden. The lads were professional, tidy, and they chipped everything on the spot. Fair price and finished in a day. Brilliant job.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Emergency call after the storm brought down a branch through our fence. They came out the same afternoon, made it safe, and gave us advice on the damaged tree. Really reassuring when you're worried. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: Dave explained exactly what he was doing with our old oak and why. It needed work but he pruned it beautifully instead of just chopping it down. You can tell he actually cares about trees, not just the invoice. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Robert H.
